n.story:
The traditional concept of 'typing' is being completely redefined. Your role is evolving from a manual data entry specialist into a high-level Document Architect and AI Editor. Instead of transcribing audio or re-typing drafts, you will manage AI agents that perform these tasks with 99% accuracy in seconds. Your value no longer lies in your words-per-minute, but in your ability to prompt, verify, and refine AI-generated content to ensure it perfectly aligns with corporate voice and complex legal requirements.

You will find yourself acting as a bridge between raw data and professional communication. You'll use AI to decode messy handwritten notes, summarize lengthy meetings into actionable emails, and transform rough outlines into perfectly formatted reports. The 'manual' part of your job is disappearing, replaced by a focus on information flow, document security, and the nuanced application of company policy that AI can assist with but cannot ultimately authorize.
auto: Manual transcription of audio and video
amp: Advanced document querying and information retrieval
Ensuring stylistic consistency across large document sets
n.adv: Transition your focus from typing speed to 'prompt engineering' and document oversight; learn to manage AI tools as your primary workforce.
